title: Madeleines
summary: The ultimate fancy high tea cake which will make you look fancy...
extendedSummary: The ultimate fancy high tea cake which will make you look fancy. I fucking adore how buttery and sweet these are, and they taste best straight out of the oven. If you want to skip the icing, dusting the bare cakes with some icing sugar works perfectly too as a way to make them look even cooler.
method: Beat egg, sugar, vanilla bean paste until light and fluffy
Combine the flour, baking powder, and then sift into the egg sugar mix... folding it until just combined
Then fold in the melted butter, also until just combined
Bake for 8-9 mins, or until they are spring-y when touched
For the matcha white chocolate topping, melt white chocolate, and combine matcha
Place a glob of the matcha chocolate onto silicone madeleine moulds, and press in the madeleines, and leave in fridge until chocolate has set
